formulaBlock.normalization: Packet canonicalInci used as normalized list (ID-2); positions are one-based on that list.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1 ether-sulfate chassis: SLES (2) is the defining anionic with two prominent buffers (Coco-Glucoside 3, Cocamidopropyl Betaine 4) and no reinforcing anionic -> moderate.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Prominent refatting (Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil 6, Glyceryl Oleate 8) argues slightly milder; does not move the C1 convention.

conditioningLevel.rationale: W-RICH rich architecture: a prominent payload lipid (Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil 6) converges with a prominent cationic polymer (Guar HPTC 9), plus a weak refatter (Glyceryl Oleate 8) and a humectant route (Glycerin 12, Panthenol 13, Sodium Hyaluronate 18) -> high anchor. C2 itself is not met (no separate pearlizing/fatty route besides the lipid that stands in for the silicone).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: No silicone; C2 not met; the hydrogenated oil amount after NaCl is unknown and may be small.

weightPotential.rationale: Two converging deposition families (waxy payload lipid 6, cationic guar 9) plus a weak refatter make noticeable but bounded residue plausible; W-RICH holds but the C1 chassis gives moderate reset, so it is not limited reset -> moderate.
weightPotential.counterSignal: W-RICH (prominent hydrogenated lipid + cationic guar) argues high.

depositionLoad.rationale: Cationic guar (9) plus prominent hydrogenated vegetable oil (6) plus glyceryl oleate (8); no silicone, no protein film.

persistence.rationale: Waxy/hydrogenated lipid is more substantive than a liquid oil; guar coacervate deposition; no silicone.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 SLES chassis buffered by glucoside and betaine: effective ordinary cleansing.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: One meaningfully persistent lipid/polymer system with a second family converging, faced by ordinary (not limited) reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W-RICH is present but resetCapacity is moderate (not limited); no silicone, no second cationic polymer, no film former. Not low: two distinct families (waxy lipid + cationic guar) both prominent, so 'lightweight' would understate residue risk (W2).
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Unknown concentration of the hydrogenated vegetable oil and guar; W-RICH vs. moderate reset boundary.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Piroctone Olamine (15) present in a complete INCI -> supported (Section 11). Whether a dandruff target follows depends on the claim (S-DANDRUFF, R17.3).
